scope: LED OKLCH production level policy, Golden parity diagnostics, and LED synthetic review samples
reason: Approve the first visual retune after the LED OKLCH production switch. Lower LED levels now carry a continuous OKLCH hue drift and chroma-scale style bias, while peak levels converge back toward the semantic center hue. Dark-mode peak lightness is lifted for stronger glow, with hue-risk peak trims keeping blue, violet, green, yellow-green, and cyan inside stable P3/sRGB fallback order.

approved_delta_classes.delta: Per-level hueDrift now decays continuously to zero at peak; chromaScale starts lower and rises monotonically, making the lowest two levels more stylized without per-sample overrides.
approved_delta_classes.guard: LEDLevelStylePolicy exposes levelProgress, hueDrift, chromaScale, lightness, chromaCap, and hueRiskAdjustment in led-parity/led-review.

approved_delta_classes.delta: Normal dark peak target moves above the prior 0.790 band, then applies hue-risk peak trims so warm hues glow more while cold/high-risk hues avoid gamut flattening.
approved_delta_classes.guard: led-parity blocker=0; strict Golden records the production LED output.

approved_delta_classes.delta: Yellow-green, green, and cyan use the same level hue-risk adjustment model, reducing low-level drift and low-scale chroma contrast relative to safer hue families.
approved_delta_classes.guard: green-risk rows remain review-required, not hidden by threshold relaxation.

approved_delta_classes.delta: LED production consumes analysis.isUltraDark as an analysis signal and applies UltraDark as OKLCH peak-lightness policy; DEBUG legacy remains the only LED HSL/Hue-cap branch.
approved_delta_classes.guard: nearMono remains neutral and UltraDark peak stays below the normal dark glow target.
